description: This file defines the AjaxResponse class, a utility class used for creating and serializing JSON responses, including status, messages, data entries, and validation messages.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class for constructing AJAX HTTP response objects with status, data, validation messages, and JSON serialization logic.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry (key-value pair) to the internal data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message based on a Throwable.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets an error message from a String.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Constructs a partial JSON string with response status and optional status message.
